tool_schemas.name: generateBanner
tool_schemas.description: Generates a short banner string for a conversation using the optional title, context hint, and max_length, and returns the generated banner text. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when max_length is not an integer or is non-positive, or when title/context_hint are not strings.

title.description: Conversation title to incorporate into the banner text.

context_hint.description: Optional context hint used to tailor the banner text.

max_length.description: Maximum length (in characters) for the generated banner text.

tool_schemas.name: checkHealth
tool_schemas.description: Checks service and backing store connectivity and returns a health status; when include_stats is true, also returns basic collection statistics. Raises UNAVAILABLE when dependencies cannot be reached or are not ready, and raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to access health details.

include_stats.description: Whether to include basic collection statistics in the health response.

tool_schemas.name: initConversation
tool_schemas.description: Finds or creates a conversation by external_conversation_key, stores the provided initial user_message in short-term memory, generates a banner (optionally using title), and returns the created/updated conversation plus recent context limited by recent_messages_limit. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid fields (including invalid content_format or non-integer limits), UNAUTHORIZED when the caller cannot create/update the conversation, and NOT_FOUND only when a referenced conversation cannot be resolved during an update path.

external_conversation_key.description: Client-provided stable key used to find or create the conversation.

title.description: Optional title to set on the conversation when creating or updating it.

user_message.description: The initial user message to store in short-term memory.

token_count.description: Optional token count for the message.

recent_messages_limit.description: How many recent messages to return as context.

tool_schemas.name: endConversation
tool_schemas.description: Appends the final assistant_message to the specified conversation, records the provided milestone in long-term project knowledge, logs the provided episode, and returns the updated conversation/end-of-conversation artifacts. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when conversation_id does not match the expected format, when required objects/fields are missing, or when enums/datetimes are invalid; raises NOT_FOUND when the conversation_id does not exist; raises CONFLICT if the conversation is not in a state that can be ended or the end operation would create an invalid state transition.

conversation_id.description: ID of the conversation to end (c10x_convo_01H8...).

assistant_message.description: Final assistant message to store in short-term memory.

token_count.description: Optional token count for the message.

milestone.description: Milestone knowledge item to record in long-term project knowledge.

effective_at.description: When the milestone became effective (RFC3339 datetime).

episode.description: Episodic log entry describing actions taken while ending the conversation.

summary.description: Short human-readable summary of the episode.

payload.description: Arbitrary structured payload for the episode.

tool_schemas.name: storeUserMessage
tool_schemas.description: Stores a user-authored message on the given conversation in short-term memory and returns the stored message record (including its assigned sequence). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid conversation_id format, missing/empty content, invalid content_format, or non-integer token_count; raises NOT_FOUND if the conversation does not exist; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot write to the conversation.

conversation_id.description: Conversation ID to attach the message to (c10x_convo_01H8...).

token_count.description: Optional token count for the message.

tool_schemas.name: storeAssistantMessage
tool_schemas.description: Stores an assistant-authored message on the given conversation in short-term memory and returns the stored message record (including its assigned sequence). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid conversation_id format, missing/empty content, invalid content_format, or non-integer token_count; raises NOT_FOUND if the conversation does not exist; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot write to the conversation.

conversation_id.description: Conversation ID to attach the message to (c10x_convo_01H8...).

token_count.description: Optional token count for the message.

tool_schemas.name: trackActiveFile
tool_schemas.description: Creates or updates an active-file tracking record for the given conversation and path, optionally grouped by repo_root, and returns the tracked file entry with its updated status and access metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid conversation_id format, missing/empty path, or invalid status; raises NOT_FOUND if the conversation does not exist; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot write file-activity for the conversation.

conversation_id.description: Conversation ID that the file activity is associated with (c10x_convo_01H8...).

path.description: File path relative to the repository root (or absolute if repo_root is not provided).

repo_root.description: Repository root identifier/path for grouping file activity.

language.description: Programming language of the file, if known.

status.description: Whether the file should be marked active or inactive.

tool_schemas.name: getRecentMessages
tool_schemas.description: Returns recent short-term messages for the conversation, ordered by sequence according to order and limited by limit; when before_sequence is provided, results are paged by returning only messages with sequence strictly less than before_sequence. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid conversation_id format, invalid order, or non-integer pagination parameters; raises NOT_FOUND if the conversation does not exist; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot read the conversation (and redacted messages are excluded unless include_redacted is true and the caller is permitted to view them).

conversation_id.description: Conversation ID to fetch messages for (c10x_convo_01H8...).

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return.

before_sequence.description: Return messages with sequence strictly less than this value (for pagination).

order.description: Sort order for returned messages by sequence.

include_redacted.description: Whether to include messages whose status is redacted.

tool_schemas.name: getActiveFiles
tool_schemas.description: Lists tracked files for a conversation filtered by status, sorted by sortBy/sortOrder, and paged using limit and the opaque cursor, returning the current page and a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid conversationId format, invalid enums, limit outside 1–200, or an invalid cursor; raises NOT_FOUND if the conversation does not exist; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot read the conversation’s working set.

conversationId.description: ID of the conversation whose active files should be returned.

status.description: Filter files by their active status.

limit.description: Maximum number of active files to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

sortBy.description: Field to sort active files by.

tool_schemas.name: storeMilestone
tool_schemas.description: Stores a milestone knowledge item for the given conversation in long-term project knowledge and returns the created milestone record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid conversationId format, missing title/body, invalid status enum, or invalid effectiveAt datetime when provided; raises NOT_FOUND if the conversation does not exist; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot write long-term knowledge for the conversation.

conversationId.description: ID of the conversation to attach this milestone to.

tags.description: Tags used to categorize or search for the milestone.

supersedesId.description: Knowledge item ID that this milestone supersedes, if any.

tool_schemas.name: storeDecision
tool_schemas.description: Creates a long-term knowledge item of type decision for the given conversation and returns the persisted decision record (including its knowledge-item ID and status). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if conversationId is not a c10x_convo_* ID, required fields (title/body) are missing/empty, status is not one of active/superseded/archived, effectiveAt is not a valid date-time, tags is not an array of strings, or supersedesId is not a c10x_kn_* ID. Raises NOT_FOUND if the conversationId does not exist or if supersedesId is provided but does not resolve to an existing knowledge item; raises CONFLICT if supersedesId refers to an item that is already superseded/archived or if the requested status transition is not allowed; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you lack access to the conversation; raises RATE_LIMITED when write quotas are exceeded.

conversationId.description: ID of the conversation to attach this decision to.

body.description: Detailed description and rationale for the decision.

tags.description: Tags used to categorize or search for the decision.

supersedesId.description: Knowledge item ID that this decision supersedes, if any.

tool_schemas.name: storeRequirement
tool_schemas.description: Creates a long-term knowledge item of type requirement for the given conversation and returns the persisted requirement record (including its knowledge-item ID and status). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if conversationId is not a c10x_convo_* ID, required fields (title/body) are missing/empty, status is not one of active/superseded/archived, effectiveAt is not a valid date-time, tags is not an array of strings, or supersedesId is not a c10x_kn_* ID. Raises NOT_FOUND if the conversationId does not exist or if supersedesId is provided but does not resolve to an existing knowledge item; raises CONFLICT if supersedesId refers to an item that is already superseded/archived or if the requested status transition is not allowed; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you lack access to the conversation; raises RATE_LIMITED when write quotas are exceeded.

conversationId.description: ID of the conversation to attach this requirement to.

tags.description: Tags used to categorize or search for the requirement.

supersedesId.description: Knowledge item ID that this requirement supersedes, if any.

tool_schemas.name: recordEpisode
tool_schemas.description: Appends an episodic log entry to the given conversation and returns the stored episode record (including its episode ID and resolved status). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if conversationId is not a c10x_convo_* ID, kind/summary are missing/empty, sequence is negative, status is not recorded or voided, occurredAt is not a valid date-time, or payload is not an object. Raises NOT_FOUND if the conversationId does not exist; raises CONFLICT if sequence is provided and is not monotonic for that conversation or if an update would imply an invalid status change (for example, un-voiding a voided episode); raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you lack access; raises RATE_LIMITED when write quotas are exceeded.

conversationId.description: ID of the conversation to attach this episode to.

kind.description: Application-defined type of action/event recorded in the episode.

payload.description: Arbitrary structured data associated with the episode.

sequence.description: Monotonic sequence number within the conversation, if provided by the caller.

occurredAt.description: Timestamp of when the episode occurred.

tool_schemas.name: getRecentEpisodes
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paged list of episodes for a conversation, filtered by optional status and kind and sorted by sortBy/sortOrder; the response includes up to limit results and a next cursor when more pages are available, which you pass back as cursor to continue. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if conversationId is not a c10x_convo_* ID, limit is outside 1–500, status/sortBy/sortOrder are not in the allowed enums, or cursor is malformed for this listing. Raises NOT_FOUND if the conversationId does not exist; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you lack access to the conversation; raises RATE_LIMITED when read quotas are exceeded.

conversationId.description: ID of the conversation whose episodes should be returned.

limit.description: Maximum number of episodes to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: getComprehensiveContext
tool_schemas.description: Builds a consolidated context bundle for a conversation by optionally including recent short-term messages, recent episodes, active working-set files, and long-term knowledge items, each truncated to its corresponding *Limit, and returns the assembled context object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if conversationId is not a c10x_convo_* ID, any limit is outside its allowed range (messages/episodes/knowledge 1–500, activeFiles 1–200), or include* flags are not booleans. Raises NOT_FOUND if the conversationId does not exist; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you lack access; raises RATE_LIMITED when read quotas are exceeded.

conversationId.description: ID of the conversation to build comprehensive context for.

messagesLimit.description: Maximum number of recent messages to include.

episodesLimit.description: Maximum number of recent episodes to include.

activeFilesLimit.description: Maximum number of active files to include.

knowledgeLimit.description: Maximum number of knowledge items to include.

includeMessages.description: Whether to include short-term conversation messages in the response.

includeActiveFiles.description: Whether to include active working-set files in the response.

includeKnowledgeItems.description: Whether to include long-term project knowledge items in the response.

includeEpisodes.description: Whether to include episodic logs in the response.

tool_schemas.name: getMemoryStats
tool_schemas.description: Returns memory-system statistics either globally or scoped to a single conversation when conversationId is provided (for example, counts and freshness across messages, active files, knowledge items, and episodes). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if conversationId is provided but is not a c10x_convo_* ID. Raises NOT_FOUND if a scoped conversationId does not exist; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you lack access to the scoped conversation (or to global stats where applicable); raises RATE_LIMITED when read quotas are exceeded.

conversationId.description: If provided, scope statistics to a single conversation; otherwise return global stats.

tool_schemas.name: getConversation
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single conversation by conversation_id and returns the conversation record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when conversation_id is invalid, NOT_FOUND when no such conversation exists, and UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to read the conversation.

conversation_id.description: ID of the conversation to fetch (c10x_convo_01H8...).

include_context.description: When true, also returns a compact context bundle (recent messages, active files, active knowledge items, recent episodes) for this conversation.

recent_messages_limit.description: How many recent messages to include when include_context is true.

recent_episodes_limit.description: How many recent episodes to include when include_context is true.

tool_schemas.name: listConversations
tool_schemas.description: Lists conversations visible to the caller, optionally filtered by status and external_conversation_key, ordered by last_activity_at descending. Returns a paginated result set. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters or pagination values, and UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to list conversations.

external_conversation_key.description: Filter by an exact client-provided external conversation key.

limit.description: Maximum number of conversations to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous listConversations call.

started_after.description: Only return conversations started after this RFC3339 datetime.

started_before.description: Only return conversations started before this RFC3339 datetime.

tool_schemas.name: redactMessage
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a stored message to status='redacted' and sets redacted_at, preventing it from appearing in recent-context reads unless explicitly requested by policy. Returns the updated message. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when ids are invalid, NOT_FOUND when the message does not exist, CONFLICT when the message is already redacted, and UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to redact messages.

message_id.description: ID of the message to redact (c10x_msg_01H8...).

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason for the redaction (stored in audit logs if enabled).
